panels.title: Distance — last 7 days
panels.description: Total distance of allowlisted activities ($activity_types) started in the trailing 7 days. Miles when $unit_system=imperial, km when metric. No activity → no-data, not zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round((sum(distance_m) / (CASE WHEN '$unit_system' = 'metric' THEN 1000.0 ELSE 1609.344 END))::numeric, 1) AS "distance"
FROM health.strava_activity
WHERE activity_type = ANY (string_to_array('$activity_types', ','))
  AND start_time >= now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Avg pace — last 7 days
panels.description: Distance-weighted average pace (total moving time ÷ total distance), shown min/mi when $unit_system=imperial, min/km when metric — not the average of each run's own pace.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN sum(distance_m) > 0 THEN to_char(make_interval(secs => round(sum(moving_time_s) / (sum(distance_m) / (CASE WHEN '$unit_system' = 'metric' THEN 1000.0 ELSE 1609.344 END)))::int), 'MI:SS') END AS "pace"
FROM health.strava_activity
WHERE activity_type = ANY (string_to_array('$activity_types', ','))
  AND start_time >= now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Avg heart rate — last 7 days
panels.description: Sample-weighted average HR via a query-time LATERAL join over each run's ELAPSED window (activities filtered to the window first, so it stays fast). Coverage indicator: '142 bpm · 3/5 runs' means only 3 of 5 runs had overlapping heart-rate data. Zero coverage → no-data, never a misleading 0.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN sum(h.n) > 0 THEN round(sum(h.s) / sum(h.n))::text || ' bpm · ' || count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.n > 0) || '/' || count(*) || ' runs' END AS "avg HR"
FROM health.strava_activity a
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(bpm) AS s FROM health.heart_rate hr
  WHERE hr.time >= a.start_time AND hr.time < a.start_time + make_interval(secs => a.elapsed_time_s)
) h ON true
WHERE a.activity_type = ANY (string_to_array('$activity_types', ','))
  AND a.start_time >= now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Distance — last 30 days
panels.description: Total distance of allowlisted activities ($activity_types) started in the trailing 30 days, in the selected unit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round((sum(distance_m) / (CASE WHEN '$unit_system' = 'metric' THEN 1000.0 ELSE 1609.344 END))::numeric, 1) AS "distance"
FROM health.strava_activity
WHERE activity_type = ANY (string_to_array('$activity_types', ','))
  AND start_time >= now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Avg pace — last 30 days
panels.description: Distance-weighted average pace over the trailing 30 days, min/mi (imperial) or min/km (metric).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN sum(distance_m) > 0 THEN to_char(make_interval(secs => round(sum(moving_time_s) / (sum(distance_m) / (CASE WHEN '$unit_system' = 'metric' THEN 1000.0 ELSE 1609.344 END)))::int), 'MI:SS') END AS "pace"
FROM health.strava_activity
WHERE activity_type = ANY (string_to_array('$activity_types', ','))
  AND start_time >= now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Avg heart rate — last 30 days
panels.description: Sample-weighted average HR over the trailing 30 days (query-time LATERAL over each run's elapsed window) with an 'N/M runs covered' indicator. Zero coverage → no-data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN sum(h.n) > 0 THEN round(sum(h.s) / sum(h.n))::text || ' bpm · ' || count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.n > 0) || '/' || count(*) || ' runs' END AS "avg HR"
FROM health.strava_activity a
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(bpm) AS s FROM health.heart_rate hr
  WHERE hr.time >= a.start_time AND hr.time < a.start_time + make_interval(secs => a.elapsed_time_s)
) h ON true
WHERE a.activity_type = ANY (string_to_array('$activity_types', ','))
  AND a.start_time >= now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Weekly mileage (last 16 weeks)
panels.description: One bar per civil week (in $timezone): total distance of allowlisted activities, in the selected unit. Training volume is inherently a time series — a ramp a 7d/30d scalar can't show. Mirrors the Scoreboard dashboard's barchart panels.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', (start_time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone')) AS "time",
       round((sum(distance_m) / (CASE WHEN '$unit_system' = 'metric' THEN 1000.0 ELSE 1609.344 END))::numeric, 1) AS "distance"
FROM health.strava_activity
WHERE activity_type = ANY (string_to_array('$activity_types', ','))
  AND start_time >= now() - interval '16 weeks'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent runs (last 30 days)
panels.description: One row per allowlisted activity. Distance/pace in the selected unit; avg HR blank when no overlapping heart-rate data (Strava activities carry no HR of their own). HR is a query-time LATERAL over each run's elapsed window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  to_char(a.start_time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "date",
  round((a.distance_m / (CASE WHEN '$unit_system' = 'metric' THEN 1000.0 ELSE 1609.344 END))::numeric, 2) AS "distance",
  CASE WHEN a.distance_m > 0 THEN to_char(make_interval(secs => round(a.moving_time_s / (a.distance_m / (CASE WHEN '$unit_system' = 'metric' THEN 1000.0 ELSE 1609.344 END)))::int), 'MI:SS') END AS "pace",
  round(a.elev_gain_m) AS "elev gain (m)",
  CASE WHEN h.n > 0 THEN round(h.avg)::text ELSE '' END AS "avg HR",
  a.name AS "name"
FROM health.strava_activity a
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) AS n, avg(bpm) AS avg FROM health.heart_rate hr
  WHERE hr.time >= a.start_time AND hr.time < a.start_time + make_interval(secs => a.elapsed_time_s)
) h ON true
WHERE a.activity_type = ANY (string_to_array('$activity_types', ','))
  AND a.start_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
ORDER BY a.start_time DESC
